name: Wyn
title: Herbalist
examine: Smells of crushed sagewort and clean snow. Speaks softly, as though the tinctures were sleeping.
lines: The ledge-flowers up here bloom a week later and last a month longer. Everything at altitude learns to hold on.
I send a crate of tinctures down to Edda's lamp every season. She sends back complaints and empty bottles, which from Edda is warm correspondence.
Drink the green one for wounds, the amber for weariness, and water for most things people buy potions for.
